title: Accommodation Type
description: Category or specification of the rentable physical space (e.g., room, apartment, villa, campsite pitch).

id.description: Unique identifier of the accommodation type.

title.description: Human-readable title of the accommodation type.

description.description: Detailed description of the accommodation type.

type.description: Kind of rentable space, as stated by the Business. Well-known values: `room`, `suite`, `apartment`, `villa`, `cabin`, `pitch`, `bed`. Businesses MAY use additional values. Independent of `property.type`: a property of one family may offer spaces of several kinds. Platforms MUST treat an unrecognized value as unclassified and MUST NOT infer the value from other fields.

capacity.description: Capacity details of the accommodation type.

media.description: Accommodation type media (images, videos, 3D models). First item is the featured media for presentation.
